nodes.label: Archived Product Definition v2
nodes.rationale: Superseded on 2026-08-09 by docs/product-definition.md. Retained as design history: manager, support, outlet-staff and verification-page descriptions grant no access and are not current requirements.

nodes.label: Staff Verification Page (Archived)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately a web page rather than a separate application: staff open a URL on any device already behind the counter, sign in with their own account, and use it — no installation, no device procurement, no app store. Part of the dashboard, not a fourth product. Deleted on 2026-08-08.

nodes.label: Rotating-QR Digital Card (Archived)
nodes.rationale: An opaque member identifier with a signed, rotating timestamp. Rotation mattered more than usual because 40% off spa treatments and 30% off room rates are worth real money: a static code that could be screenshotted and forwarded would be worth money, so the payload refreshes and an old screenshot fails validation.

nodes.label: Three-Role Staff Access Table (Archived)
nodes.rationale: Administrator (everything), Manager (members and reports, no benefit or staff configuration), Outlet staff (verification page only, no member list or reports). Outlet staff cannot browse the membership, and given who the members are that restriction is not a formality.

nodes.label: Ten Open Questions
nodes.rationale: The original list the build's Q-numbering derives from, headed by what the existing QR code does, which determines the redemption build. Also asks how many members exist today — the reference card is number three, which is what makes a careful narrow pilot cheap.
